feed.title: CiMAS
feed.subtitle: Guidance, navigation, and control for resilient autonomy in multi-agent systems

entry.title: CiMAS opens!
entry.content: Welcome to the Control Group for Intelligent Multi-agent Systems (CiMAS)! We study scalable, robust guidance, navigation, and control frameworks, alongside individual agent interactions, to achieve resilient autonomy in multi-agent systems. The lab opens in the Department of Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering at DGIST in October 2026.
